aviso_versao.texto: A new joBot version is available: {versao}.
aviso_versao.janela: The joBot window has a new version too.
aviso_versao.janela_aberta: The new version's page opened in your browser.
aviso_versao.janela_falhou: Could not open the browser. Download the new window at {endereco}
aviso_versao.atualizando: Updating joBot. The panel reloads by itself when the new version opens.
aviso_versao.demorou: Two minutes went by and the new version did not open. What happened is in the file logs/atualizar.log, in the data folder (Settings › Privacy).
aviso_versao.nao_comecou: Could not start the update. The reason is in the joBot log, in the data folder (Settings › Privacy).
aviso_versao.sem_js: This page checks again every 5 seconds and goes back to the panel when the new version opens. If it takes more than two minutes, see the file logs/atualizar.log in the data folder (Settings › Privacy).
